gloss: 110; the police emergency number in Japan

definitions.gloss: 110; Japan's police emergency number; a call to the police
definitions.explanation: The three-digit number dialled to reach the police in an emergency. Also used with する to mean 'to call the police.' Normally written 110{番|ばん} in figures.

examples.japanese: すぐに{百十番|ひゃくとおばん}してください。
examples.english: Please call the police right away.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}を{見|み}て{百十番|ひゃくとおばん}に{通報|つうほう}した。
examples.english: I saw the accident and reported it to the police.

examples.japanese: {緊急|きんきゅう}でない{相談|そうだん}は、{百十番|ひゃくとおばん}ではなく{警察相談|けいさつそうだん}ダイヤルにかける。
examples.english: For non-emergency matters you call the police consultation line rather than 110.

notes:
Written 110{番|ばん} in ordinary text; the kanji spelling {百十番|ひゃくとおばん} appears mainly when the reading has to be shown. Note that {十|とお} is read とお here, not じゅう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百十番|ひゃくとおばん}する: to call the police
- {百十番|ひゃくとおばん}{通報|つうほう}: a 110 call, an emergency report to police
- {百十番|ひゃくとおばん}にかける: to dial 110

OTHER EMERGENCY NUMBERS:
- 119{番|ばん}: fire and ambulance
- 118{番|ばん}: coast guard (maritime emergencies)
